name: 06333 · East Lyme, CT
findings: ZIP 06333 (East Lyme) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06333 (East Lyme) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06333 (East Lyme) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
